# `fnox daemon start`

- **Usage:** `fnox daemon start`

Start the daemon in the background

Starts the per-user daemon unless it is already running. Commands use it only while it is enabled with `[daemon] enabled = true` or `FNOX_DAEMON=on`.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

**Start the daemon**

```sh
fnox daemon start
```
